newsArray.title: Sports News | Harry Brook Becomes England's First ODI Double Centurion, Fastest in 50-over Format
newsArray.description: Get latest articles and stories on Sports at LatestLY. During the match against Sri Lanka, taking place as part of a tri-nation series also involving Pakistan in Rawalpindi, Brook slammed a whirlwind 202 in 116 balls, with 21 fours and 10 sixes at a strike rate of 174.14. He surpassed Indian skipper Shubman Gill's record of fastest double ton in ODIs. Gill had made a 117-ball double ton against West Indies recently, while Brook did it better with a 114-ball effort.
